name: Lobby: left bags (CAVIAR, real footage)
description: Three ceiling cameras in a lobby. A bag is left on the exit walkway, by the seating area, and at the reception desk (later picked up). People walk through every zone and must never trigger a bag rule. Tracks are CAVIAR's hand-labelled ground truth replayed over the real video, so this scene runs with no detector and no Gemini key.
policy: Keep the exit walkway clear; alert if a bag or chair blocks it for more than 5 seconds. Alert if a bag is left in the seating area for more than 10 seconds. Alert if a bag is left at the reception desk for more than 10 seconds.
credits: Video and ground truth: EC Funded CAVIAR project/IST 2001 37540, CC BY-SA (homepages.inf.ed.ac.uk/rbf/CAVIARDATA1/)
